answer_1.quote: Our work studies occupational gender bias in translating gender-ambiguous inputs, adding to ongoing research on gender bias in NLP with a focus on occupations and the labor market.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates machine translation systems on gender bias in occupational terms when translating from English to gendered languages like Greek and French.

answer_2.quote: To quantify gender bias in MT and compare model outputs against reference distributions, we introduce the Gender RAtio ProbabilitiEs (GRAPE).

answer_3.quote: We employ an LLM-based component in a few-shot setup, prompting it to extract all explicitly mentioned occupation titles in the text.
methods: few-shot prompting for occupation extraction and gender identification

answer_4.quote: Validation involved discarding any texts that were not fluent or where occupational terms were not gender-ambiguous. The experts carried out this task as part of their work in a funded project and were compensated according to national standards.
answer_4.guideline: Discard texts that are not fluent or where occupational terms are not gender-ambiguous.
